title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is given as: L(theta_0,theta_1)=1/n*sum{i=1}{n}(y_i-log(theta_0)/theta_0-theta_1*x_i+theta_0*theta_1). This function is used to optimize the predicted monthly profits.

title: Initial Values and Learning Rate
text: The initial values are $${\theta_0}^0=1$$ and $${\theta_1}^0=2$$. The learning rate alpha is set to $$0.5$$.

title: Gradient Descent Step
text: In gradient descent, the parameters are updated using the formula: $$\theta_{new}=\theta_{old}-\alpha gradient$$.

title: Calculate the Gradient for $$\theta_0$$
text: To find the gradient of L with respect to $$\theta_0$$, differentiate the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$.

title: Update $$\theta_0$$
text: Using the gradient descent formula, update $$\theta_0$$: $$\theta_{0,new}=\theta_{0,old}-\alpha gradient$$.
